版本: 20260306
作者: 知秋
1. 使用服务器进行中转，有请求速率限制，小说为一分钟300次，支持小说下载请不要太夸张。
2. 临时token口令为 天一团队是倒狗(qq为1070240776和845646066和1484608559)请勿相信任何需要付费的说法欢迎来官方反馈群举报
3. 获取token请点击登录界面，获取token按钮，点击测试/修改token可查询日下载量，切记获取token后请保存，最后选择√存储成功，token为3日有效期，到期请重新获取，切记token变为明文，请勿外泄，异地登录多次会封禁token，如封禁请等过期重新获取。(token改为明文存源变量中防止丢失)
4. 共享数据库如有，则优先使用数据库，共享章节开头的图标为🍅
5. 支持下载，请把预下载改成0-10之间，请求有超限拉黑，请勿大规模批量下载
6. 搜索类型会随着书源模式改变，听书模式，默认搜索听书
7.   搜索小说：以字母n开头；
      搜索漫画：以字母c开头；
      搜索听书：以字母a开头；
      搜索短剧：以字母v开头；
8. 听小说模式适配ai音色听书，选择此模式刷新发现即可，详情页有书籍支持音色，自定义音色听书或者采取下列方式也可(注意听书模式为真人主播，自定义音色无法生效)
    ai配音听书需要a➕bookid搜索即可，默认皆为真人(小说的支持ai音色请看小说详情页简介处的音色即可获得，每个数字代表一个音色)
9. 反馈q群：755947375，token问题群里找我，或者社区找也行(社区不经常在线，上线看到会回)
10. 段评，章评，书评。在登录界面开启关闭
11. 颜色可以在登录界面自行更改
12. 接口请求速率存在限制，请不要大规模下载，耐心等待。

<js>
let ck = "sessionid=" + (String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) ? String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) : (source.getLoginInfoMap() || {})['手动登录Token'])

function getBooksInfo(novelIds) {
  let urls = []
  novelIds.forEach(i => {
    urls.push(getApiUrl('/novel/info', { novelId: i }))
  })
  let res = java.ajaxAll(urls)
  let resp = { book_info: [] }
  res.forEach(r => {
    resp.book_info.push(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
  })
  return resp
}

let getShelf = () => {
  let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'
  let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
      'Cookie': ck
    }
  }))
  let bids = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
  return getBooksInfo(bids)
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
  let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'

  let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
      'Cookie': ck,
    }
  })))
  let group_bookids = {
    "未分组": []
  }
  book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
    if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
    group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
  })
  if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return { data: [] }
  let book_ids = group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]
  return getBooksInfo(book_ids)
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
  let url = xGorgon(
    "bookmall/tab",
    "version_name=5.8.9.32&device_id=1024&device_type=114514&iid=2048",
    null,
    ck
  )
  let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
  let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index]
  tab = tab.cell_data
  if (!tab) tab = []
  let bookList = []
  for (let i of tab) {
    if (!i.book_data) {
      let nexttab = i.cell_data || []
      nexttab
        .filter(i => i.show_type === 125)
        .forEach(i => bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data || []))
    } else {
      bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    }
  }
  return { book_info: bookList }
}

if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
else {
  let w = baseUrl.split("/")
  if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
    result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
  } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
    result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
  } else if (baseUrl.includes("reading.snssdk.com")) {
    bids = baseUrl.match(/book_id=([\d,]+)/)[1].split(",")
    result = getBooksInfo(bids)
  } else {
    java.log(result)
    result = JSON.parse(result)
  }
}

java.log('result:' + JSON.stringify(result))
JSON.stringify({ data: result.book_info || result.data.book_info || result.detail_list || result.data.novels || (result.data.cell_view && result.data.cell_view.book_data) || result.data })
</js>

var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
            
var document = JsDom.parse(src);
            
// 获取包含<li>元素的<div>元素
var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

//java.log(JSON.stringify(list));
list;
</js>

  aid,
  cid,
  token: chapterToken,
  timestamp,
  nonce
};

    .map(x=>x.join("=")).join("&");
let headers = {
	 "Referer": baseUrl,
	 "Accept":	"text/plain, */*; q=0.01",
  "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest"
}
url = "https://www.deqixs.co/modules/article/ajax2.php?"+paramStr+","+JSON.stringify({
	 headers
})

java.ajax(url)

    if (!res || res.code != 0 || !res.data || !res.data.sources) {
        return [{
            title: '请先登陆，登陆后刷新发现页即可',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < res.data.sources.length; i++) {
        if (res.data.sources[i] && res.data.sources[i].name == so) {
            sourceItem = res.data.sources[i];
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!sourceItem || !sourceItem.tabs || sourceItem.tabs.length == 0) {
        return [{
            title: '暂无' + (so || '') + '发现内容',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < sourceItem.tabs.length; i++) {
        tab = sourceItem.tabs[i];

        if (!tab) {
            continue;
        }

        if (tab.section) {
            if (count > 0) {
                while (count < 3) {
                    result.push({
                        title: '--',
                        url: '',
                        style: {
                            layout_flexGrow: 1,
                            layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                        }
                    });
                    count++;
                }
            }

            result.push({
                title: tab.title || '',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
                }
            });

            count = 0;
            continue;
        }

        u = '/api/discover/content?source='
            + encodeURIComponent(sourceItem.source || '')
            + '&tab='
            + encodeURIComponent(tab.key || '')
            + '&page={{page}}&page_size=12';

        result.push({
            title: tab.title || '',
            url: Api(u),
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
            }
        });

        count++;

        if (count >= 3) {
            count = 0;
        }
    }

    if (count > 0) {
        while (count < 3) {
            result.push({
                title: '--',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                }
            });

            count++;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

<js>
  function login() {
  	 const user = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("账号"))
    const pw = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("密码"))
    let sign = java.md5Encode(`isDevice=Android&password=${pw}&phone=${user}&regDevice=2&key=87ac02d392a8d3566fe7748c8de00af3&secrect=57dcuidu8aa8062bfe8042ea65310669`).toString().toUpperCase()
    let data = JSON.stringify({
      isDevice: "Android",
      password: pw,
      phone: user,
      regDevice: "2",
      sign: sign
    })
    let op = JSON.stringify({
      method: "POST",
      body: data
    })
    let res = java.ajax(`https://api.shaoniandream.com/Login/login,${op}`)
    let $ = JSON.parse(res)
    if($.status != 1) java.toast($.msg)
    java.put("uid",$.data.id)
    source.putLoginHeader(JSON.stringify({
      logintoken: $.data.logintoken
    }))
  	}
</js>

  let $ = JSON.parse(result)

  let array = []
  $.data.chapterList.forEach((booklet) => {

    	 isv: true
    })
    booklet.chapterList.forEach((chapter) => {
    	 let sign = java.md5Encode(`BookID=${$.data.id}&UserID=${uid}&chapter_id=${chapter.id}&isDevice=Android&isMarket=true&regDevice=2&key=87ac02d392a8d3566fe7748c8de00af3&secrect=57dcuidu8aa8062bfe8042ea65310669`).toString().toUpperCase()
    	 let data = JSON.stringify({
    	   BookID: $.data.id,
    	   UserID: uid,
    	   chapter_id: chapter.id,
    	   isDevice: "Android",
    	   isMarket:"true",
    	   regDevice: "2",
    	   sign: sign
    	 })
      let op = JSON.stringify({
        method: "POST",
        body: data
      })
      array.push({
        name: chapter.title,
        url: "https://api.shaoniandream.com/Booklibrary/readchapter," + op,
        time: java.timeFormat(chapter.release_time_now * 1000),
        vip: chapter.isFree == 1,
        buy: chapter.lock == 1
      })
    })
  })
  array
</js>

ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
var bookid = baseUrl.match(/novel\/(\d+)/)[1];
//书评发送
const bookva = book.getVariable("custom");
if (bookva && bookva != "") {
    if (source.getLoginHeader()) {
        const commenturl = `${GetUL()}/home/comment/add.html`;
        let body = `content=${bookva}&type=novel&mid=${bookid}`;
        
        try {
            const code = String(java.getVerificationCode(`data:image/svg+xml;base64,${codesvg}`));
            
            if (code == "评论" || /^@\d+$/.test(code)) {
                if (/^@\d+$/.test(code)) {
                    body += `&pid=${code.match(/(\d+)/)[1]}`;
                }
                
                const headers = { "x-requested-with": "XMLHttpRequest" };
                const response = java.post(commenturl, body, headers).body();
                java.toast(JSON.parse(response).msg);
            } else {
                Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(40);
                java.toast('请按图片要求填写');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            java.log(err);
        }
    } else {
        java.toast("未登录，请登录后操作");
    }
    book.putCustomVariable("");
}

try {
    sourceinfo = source.getLoginInfoMap();
    sourceinfo['书籍ID'] = bookid;
    if (bookid) {
        source.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(sourceinfo));
    }
    $ = _ => String(java.getString(_));
    img = /^https?/.test($('[property$=image]@content')) ? $('[property$=image]@content') : GetUL() + $('[property$=image]@content');
    list = {
        "ID": bookid,
        "img": img,
        "name": $('[property$=book_name]@content'),
        "author": $('[property$=author]@content'),
        "info": $('[property$=description]@content').slice(0, 45),
        "url": "legado://import/addToBookshelf?src=" + baseUrl
    }
    source.put("list", JSON.stringify(list));
} catch (err) {
    java.log("登录UI未初始化保存数据：" + err);
}
src;
</js>
